title: Chapter 80
content_en: MGA: Chapter 80 – Unrivaled GeniusOn the top of the testing rock, it was originally red. But if one looked closely, they would discover, on the top of the red section, there would be a small black dot as big as a sesame. The strangest thing was that currently, on the small dot, it was flickering with black light.“Did that boy activate the section in the legends?”At that instant, the old man’s eyes couldn’t help but flicker and his breathing quickened. It was as if his body was going to fall apart and he also started to violently tremble.On a complete testing rock, it originally had 4 colours. The peak was not the red colour.
